text:
Leah (CS): Drafting a tiny activation priming cheat for customer kickoffs — aim: predictable first-72h, minimal cold-starts, clear fallback. Pls quick review.

Ravi (Eng): love it. Defaults I recommend: batch_size=6 for short-turn convo, batch_size=3 for strict latency; prefill 30 requests; concurrency=2 for first 15m.

Anne (SRE): add ops thresholds: if 5xx > 4% for 3m OR p95 > 900ms => trigger traffic-shift to fallback model and notify #release-war-room. Include a simple Datadog alert query.

Leah (CS): customer-friendly prefill script (1-liner):
`seq 1 30 | xargs -n1 -P4 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello","max_tokens":12}'`

Kai (PM): add renewal signal items: baseline latency at t0, cache-hit%% after 24h, error budget burn, and a 72h sentiment note from CS. Surface these in kickoff mail.

Leah (CS): wording for kickoff email: "We'll run a 30-minute priming window to warm your tenant cache and tune batching. We'll send a 24h metrics snapshot and do a 72h check-in. If errors spike we'll failover to a compact fallback model and let you know."

Ravi (Eng): quick cost note: estimate tokens for 30 prefill reqs at rwd-3b ~ small charge; Dedicated customers can request reserved warm pools to avoid burst charges.

Leah (CS): ops preflight checklist (short): confirm firewall/KMS, pin model version, run 10 smoke queries, verify logs to observability. Go-live window: enable 1.5x burst, monitor alerts, daily CS pulse. Degrade plan: switch to quantized model, throttle batch size, open incident.

cs-bot: follow-up reminder set for @Leah (CS) in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:

Leah (CS): thanks team — I'll add to the enablement repo and the kickoff template. Tag me if you want edits. :pray:
